title: Quarterly initiative airlock and goal onramp for cross-functional deliveries
creator: Marco Nguyen
description:
Problem: At quarter boundaries we have uneven intake of initiatives into the delivery pipeline —some teams push half-baked scopes while others miss alignment windows— which causes execution churn, rework, and underutilized dedicated capacity (Dedicated pools + rollout windows).

Proposal: Create a lightweight, repeatable 'initiative airlock' and 'goal onramp' process that sits between discovery and execution for company-level initiatives. The airlock enforces a short readiness rubric and a transfer manifest (scope, success metrics, tech dependencies, rollout constraints, estimated capacity). The onramp standardizes the first 6 weeks of execution: acceptance criteria, canary plan, owner-level commitments, and telemetry hooks.

Outcomes: (1) reduce kickoff rework by 30% for cross-functional initiatives, (2) improve SLA adherence for Dedicated rollouts (target 95% on-time canary), (3) give leadership a clear signal for go/no-go at the quarter boundary.

Scope: This ticket designs the playbook, builds a checklist template, prototypes the intake form (Confluence + lightweight API to sync with Linear), and pilots the flow with 3 initiatives in Q2. Implementation of tooling hooks (console dashboard integration, PR templates) will be in follow-ups with ENG and DES.
acceptance_criteria: Airlock playbook written and published in Confluence with actionable checklist

Stakeholder sign-off (Eng, Design, Security, Sales Ops) on the go/no-go rubric
